claim: Within economies where the 2024 Global Findex borrowing/digital-payment module was administered, making or receiving a digital payment is associated with a +3.6 percentage-point-higher probability of having borrowed from a formal financial institution in the past 12 months, conditional on account ownership, demographics and economy fixed effects. Descriptive within-economy association only; not causal.
method: survey-weighted linear probability model, economy fixed effects, w_equal weights
sample: 100,560 adults in 97 economies, 2024 Global Findex wave, complete primary covariates; 10,214 formal borrowers
statistical_test: economy-clustered (CR1) standard error; Rademacher wild-cluster bootstrap (999)

verifications.detail: Independent cold-context re-implementation (hand-rolled WLS + CR1, no Codex code read); M1 b1 reproduces to abs delta 3.5e-14; drop table and 100,560/97 frame reproduced step for step.

verdict_notes.identification_credibility: FLAWED for any causal reading: single 2024 cross-section, no temporal ordering, digital-payment activity and formal borrowing mechanically linked through account ownership. Reported strictly as a conditional within-economy association; a causal reading is prohibited by the claim contract.
